items.title: 68356_Howard R. Scott oral history interview
items.q: He was a doggone good trumpet player, and Roy came along and at the time they needed somebody like him

ctx.x: At one time, he was sounding exactly like Roy Eldridge.

Well, see, he's so dizzy, he tries to play everybody. What did Dizzy do, trying to be like Roy Eldridge? He was a doggone good trumpet player, and Roy came along and at the time they needed somebody like him, because Louis had gone on his own, with his own band, travelling all over the world.
And Roy came along at a time when they needed somebody just like him. He was good, too. And Rex Stuart, he was a good trumpet player.
